narrative.highlights:
Staff Cost vs Budget: Significantly below budget, delivering a 14% YTD saving. May–June increase reflects April salary increases; June adjustment rebalances payroll provisions.

Electrification Project: Works in Zamba commenced and are progressing satisfactorily against the implementation plan.

Staff incentives paid: Bonus paid at Lubudi (100%), Zamba and HQ Kinshasa. Very positive reception on all three sites; staff committed to extra effort so the bonus becomes regular.
narrative.lowlights:
Road Safety: LOXEA accident near Nsele (Honoré Samba / Patrick Kodjowa). Investigations ongoing; CNPR engagement given Plant–HO accidents this year.

Resignations: Clement Ndusha (Graduate) resigned in July (not yet in stats). Grassinda — classification done; decision to let her go and relaunch at the same grade. Happy Iyanya — requested the 15th; asked to remain until 30/31 for handover (delay to confirm with ExCo).

Recruitment: Lab Analyst (Zamba) declined the offer (re-advertise). CRO offers sent, awaiting response. Lab Analyst Plant and Warehouse Officer accepted, starting soon.

Community Relations: Nanga/Zamba CLC new committee (Mr. Aimé Luzayadio, CEO of Gringo). Kuzi Clan claims near Malanga Gare. Lubudi — chief of Mulumbu requesting preferential consideration.
narrative.focus:
Family Day: Confirmed — 27 Aug at Zamba Plant; 5 Sep at Head Office (Kinshasa). Priority is organisation of both events.

MD Services replacement: Procurement expected to close this month. Focus on transition and handover.

Office design payments: Confirm with Marie whether designer payments are closed and current stage.

Early retirement — Charles Pongo-Pongo (QA Manager): Request under review; currently on PIP.

Medical cases: Yannick Kalambayi (Instrumentation); Toubi Nzazi (Drilling); Lab employee (mental health) — contract expires August.
narrative.approvalItems: Auction of four company vehicles: two Toyota Hilux, one Toyota Coaster bus, and one Toyota Land Cruiser.
